what_it_is: The first submission. One graph neural network (Chemprop with the CheMeleon foundation encoder) trained once on all 4,905 compounds, four prediction heads, no correction of any kind.

Per-isoform simple-average ensembles chosen by cross-validation in notebook 08, retrained on all compounds. CYP2C9's 'ensemble' was a single config, so its column is a different model from the other three.
The same recipe as 04b, retrained once under the current environment as a control. Raw, no correction. The reference every later model is compared to.
Caruana greedy-selection ensembles, capped per isoform at the cross-validation optimum: 3 to 8 members per isoform drawn from 8 distinct configs, all trained on all compounds. Raw.
Three isoforms of 10c and one of NB12, all pushed onto an external reference population's mean and spread (PubChem AID 1851).
correction_layers: CYP1A2: population calibration (AID 1851 moments); CYP2C9: population calibration (AID 1851 moments); CYP2D6: population calibration (AID 1851 moments); CYP3A4: population calibration (AID 1851 moments)

what_it_is: 10c's own predictions, with CYP2C9 and CYP2D6 recentred onto a blind population solved from this project's own earlier board metrics. CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 untouched.
correction_layers: CYP2C9: recentred onto solved blind population; CYP2D6: recentred onto solved blind population (mean 3.155762, sd 1.511412)

what_it_is: NB16 with CYP2C9 swapped back to NB12's ensemble column.
NB19 with CYP2D6's spread widened to 0.85 of the training-label spread.
correction_layers: CYP2D6: recentred (mean 3.155762) then widened x1.397056 to ratio 0.85

what_it_is: One Chemprop model trained with four extra auxiliary prediction heads carrying PubChem AID 1851 efficacy data, bringing 16,459 compounds the scored labels do not cover into the encoder's training pool. Raw, uncorrected.
BANNED BY THE HARD CONSTRAINT -- excluded at every stage, including as a reference.
model: aid (AID-1851 auxiliary heads) + caruana-capped ensembles + plain-v2 (chemprop_chemeleoninit)

what_it_is: The AID model again, but trained against a 'dead-zone' target: each label replaced by the model's own out-of-fold prediction clipped into that compound's credible interval. CYP2D6 placed and widened; the other three raw.
correction_layers: CYP2D6: placed x1.708956 then widened x1.118063 to ratio 0.85

what_it_is: NB32-A's own file with CYP1A2, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 widened about their means to the spread ratio of whichever column held that isoform's best board reading. CYP2D6 carried over unchanged.
correction_layers: CYP1A2: widened x1.414452 to ratio 0.8361; CYP2C9: widened x1.130370 to ratio 0.8168; CYP3A4: widened x1.131699 to ratio 0.9262; CYP2D6: inherited from NB32-A (placed then widened to 0.85); not re-widened

what_it_is: The plain Chemprop recipe retrained once with an absolute-error training loss instead of squared error -- the leak-free half of the dead-zone effect, since it changes the loss alone and keeps the literal label. CYP1A2 widened, CYP2D6 placed and widened.
correction_layers: CYP1A2: widened x1.163109 to ratio 0.8361; CYP2D6: widened x1.910924 to ratio 0.8500 after placement onto the solved blind population

what_it_is: A non-negative weighted blend fitted per isoform on 25-fold out-of-fold predictions and deployed on existing full-data columns: dead-zone plus AID plus one tree model per isoform. No new training.
correction_layers: CYP1A2: widened to board-best ratio; CYP3A4: widened to board-best ratio; CYP2D6: placed on the blend's own OOF rho (0.4525) then widened to 0.85

what_it_is: A single blend object -- one weight vector shared across all four isoforms (dead-zone 0.625 / AID 0.25 / gradient-boosted trees 0.125). The only non-deliberate submission this project has made.
correction_layers: CYP1A2: widened; CYP3A4: widened; CYP2D6: placed on the blend's own OOF rho (0.4496) then widened to 0.85
